caseName: Warfield Co. v. American Lecithin Co.
caseNameFull: Warfield Company v. American Lecithin Co. and American Lecithin Co. v. Warfield Company
attorneys: Messrs. Russell Wiles and George A. Chritton for the Warfield Company. Messrs. Thomas G. Haight, Edward G. Curtis, Daniel L. Morris, and Ira J. Wilson for the American Lecithin Co. By leave of Court,Messrs. George P. Dike and Cedric W. Porter filed a brief on behalf of the Dewey & Almy Chemical Co., as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of cer-tiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.

Reported below: 105 F. 2d 207.
